title: serious or undo
rule: Before actions with serious consequences (especially those that cannot be undone), use a confirmation dialog, or offer an undo window; never make destruction immediate.

citation.source: NN/g — Confirmation Dialogs (§1); NN/g — Cancel vs Close (ask for confirmation); Vercel Web Interface Guidelines (destructive actions need confirmation modal or undo)

pass_when: Serious / irreversible actions have a confirmation dialog or an undo window; destruction is not immediate.
fail_when: Immediate irreversible destructive commit with neither confirm nor undo.
waive_reason: agent_fields pending — do not invent from harvest stencil
